@tbl-wide14 is wide enough that the layout ladder BOTH rotates it AND still
has to shrink its type below the 10 pt default to fit the rotated budget --
the combination D38 (dev/specs/2026-07-31-phase2-decisions.md; the Route A
shrink ladder, carried by apaquarto fork commit 125cbe4 on branch
apatables-bundle) left unverified through a real render ("rotation's
interaction with this marker is NOT yet built or verified... a table that
both rotates AND shrinks is untested here"), because apatablelandscape.lua
(Task 6) did not exist yet.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-wide14
#| tbl-cap: "Fourteen Variable Correlations"
#| echo: false
set.seed(1)
d14 <- as.data.frame(matrix(rnorm(30 * 14), ncol = 14))
names(d14) <- paste0("Var", 1:14)
apaTables:::apa_quarto_markdown_block(apa.cor.table(d14))
```
